requirements.name: LRE_Beh
requirements.description: A State Machine named "LRE_Beh" shall be created to model the behaviour of the LRE.

requirements.name: Variable1
requirements.description: LRE_Beh shall define a boolean Variable "inOPEZ", which is true when the AUV is within an Operating Prohibited/Exclusion Zone (OPEZ).

requirements.name: Variable2
requirements.description: LRE_Beh shall define a boolean Variable "collisionRisk", which is true when the Closest Distance of Approach (CDA) to a dynamic obstacle is below the minimum safe distance and the Time to Closest Point of Approach (TCPA) is non-negative.

requirements.name: Variable3
requirements.description: LRE_Beh shall define a boolean Variable "staticObstacleNear", which is true when the closest static obstacle is within the allowed caution distance (horizontally or vertically).

requirements.name: Variable4
requirements.description: LRE_Beh shall define a boolean Variable "velocityHigh", which is true when the AUV velocity is at or above the manoeuvre threshold.

requirements.name: State1
requirements.description: The LRE shall define a State named "OCM" (Operation Control Mode).

requirements.name: State2
requirements.description: The LRE shall define a State named "MOM" (Main Operating Mode). On entering MOM, the Event "advVel" (Output) shall be triggered to advise the AUV to manoeuvre.

requirements.name: State3
requirements.description: The LRE shall define a State named "CAM" (Collision Avoidance Mode).

requirements.name: State4
requirements.description: The LRE shall define a State named "HCM" (High Caution Mode). On entering HCM, the Event "advVel" (Output) shall be triggered to advise the AUV to slow down.

requirements.name: Beh1
requirements.description: On start up, the LRE shall be in the OCM mode.

requirements.name: Beh2
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from OCM to OCM if the Event "reqVel" (Input) is triggered; then the Event "advVel" (Output) shall be triggered.

requirements.name: Beh3
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from OCM to OCM if the Event "reqHdng" (Input) is triggered; then the Event "advHdng" (Output) shall be triggered.

requirements.name: Beh4
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from OCM to MOM, with a trigger Event "reqMOM" (Input), with the condition that: "velocityHigh" is false, "collisionRisk" is false, "staticObstacleNear" is false, and "inOPEZ" is false.

requirements.name: Beh5
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to OCM, if "inOPEZ" is true.

requirements.name: Beh6
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to OCM, if the Event "reqOCM" is triggered.

requirements.name: Beh7
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to OCM, if the Event "endTask" is triggered; then the Event "advVel" (Output) shall be triggered.

requirements.name: Beh8
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to CAM, if "collisionRisk" is true.

requirements.name: Beh9
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to HCM, if "velocityHigh" is true and "staticObstacleNear" is true.

requirements.name: Beh10
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to HCM, if "staticObstacleNear" is true.

requirements.name: Beh11
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to HCM, if "velocityHigh" is true and "staticObstacleNear" is true.

requirements.name: Beh12
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from MOM to HCM, if the Event "reqHCM" is triggered.

requirements.name: Beh13
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from HCM to MOM, if "staticObstacleNear" is false.

requirements.name: Beh14
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from HCM to CAM, if "collisionRisk" is true.

requirements.name: Beh15
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from HCM to OCM, if the Event "reqOCM" is triggered.

requirements.name: Beh16
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from HCM to OCM, if "inOPEZ" is true.

requirements.name: Beh17
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from CAM to OCM, if the Event "reqOCM" is triggered.

requirements.name: Beh18
requirements.description: The LRE shall transition from CAM to OCM, if "collisionRisk" is false.
